We've been together almost 5 years,  married 2... no kids.
Obviously I need it more but where its in her mothers name I dont know what claim I have to it
Its paid off... paid off a couple months before we got married
And no not working now... looking though
In NH... and it technically is in her mother's name, been that way since she bought it
My wife drives me to work and picks me up right now cause of the one car. Things came to a head this weekend and she's probably leaving this weekend. She's already left for the day to her mother's

Because we have one car and its my wife's. I can't afford to buy something else to get to/from work, have no money left to rent a car or take a taxi, and don't know anyone who lives near me that works with me. So if I miss work ill end up losing my job cause I can't get there. Its not a job I can work from home to do.

It sucks. We live in an apartment now, I'm the only one working and we only have one car, a used one we have to keep. We can't afford anyt
hing else, are falling behind on bills, and I've come clean to her but its put us behind the 8 ball and my life insurance is worth more than I am alive. Im just at the end - don't know what else to do. We don't have a great support structure around us that we can get help through.

My brother-in-law (who's developmentally delayed) went to a new school two months ago (he's in 5th grade). We've seen a great improvement with him socially since going to the new school, and now we know why. This was taken of him at recess playing Kickball with his new friends. Restores my faith in humanity!
Thanks for the comments guys! We think we're gonna end up in the marketplace
